name: Terra Nova National Park
policyReason: Dogs are allowed on trails on leash; no trail bans are listed.
summary: Leashed dogs are allowed on trails; five oTENTiks are pet-friendly.

excerpts.quote: Keep your dog under control and on a leash at all times.
Sleep soundly in one of our five pet-friendly oTENTik units, the perfect mix of a tent and A-frame cabin, for a hassle-free trip for the entire family.

dogRules.text: Dogs on trails must be leashed and under control.
Never leave dogs unattended outside; store dog food securely.
